## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `poetry run pytest` passes
- [ ] `poetry run ruff check .`, `poetry run ruff format --check .` and `poetry run mypy` pass
- [ ] Public API changes have Google-style docstrings (with an example where practical)
- [ ] User-visible changes are listed under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] New imputers are exported from `imputation_methods/__init__.py` and listed in `README.md`
